draft.title: Finance and other parts of the business
card: Finance does not work alone. Financial decisions affect operations, marketing and human resources, and these areas also shape what finance can do.
Operations
Buying new machinery or stock needs funds from finance. In turn, how efficiently operations run changes the costs and profit that finance reports.
Marketing
An advertising campaign is paid for from the budget that finance sets. Sales from marketing bring in the cash that finance manages.
Human resources
The wages bill and the cost of hiring and training staff depend on finance. The size and skill of the workforce affect costs and output.
draft.remember: Finance supplies the funds for other areas, and those areas shape the costs and income that finance manages.

a.q: Which example shows marketing depending on finance?
opts: A campaign goes ahead only if the budget has funds for it
Higher sales lead to fewer complaints from customers
A new logo is chosen to suit the target market
Staff are trained to explain products to customers
a.why: Marketing needs money to run a campaign, and finance sets the budget that provides it. The training option is tempting, but it is about staff skills and does not show marketing relying on funds from finance.
a.clue: Look for the one where money from finance decides what marketing can do.

b.q: Priya owns a bakery in Bathurst. She borrows money to buy a faster oven. Which result shows operations affecting finance, not finance affecting operations?
opts: The oven cuts the cost of each loaf, so profit rises
The loan lets the bakery buy the oven
The bank sets the repayment dates for the loan
Priya sets aside funds to cover the oven's servicing
b.why: Lower cost per loaf comes from how operations run, and it changes the profit that finance reports. The loan is tempting, but it shows finance supplying funds to operations, which is the opposite direction.
b.clue: Which result starts in the production area and ends in the financial results?

a.best: A campaign goes ahead only if the budget has funds for it

b.best: The oven cuts the cost of each loaf, so profit rises

proposal.title: Finance and other parts of the business
card: Finance does not work alone. Financial decisions affect operations, marketing and human resources, and these areas also shape what finance can do.
Operations

Marketing
An advertising campaign is paid for from the budget that finance sets. Sales from marketing bring in the cash that finance manages.
Human resources

proposal.remember: Finance supplies the funds for other areas, and those areas shape the costs and income that finance manages.

a.q: Which example shows marketing depending on finance?
opts: A campaign is scaled back after finance cuts its budget
Marketing lifts sales, bringing in cash to repay a loan
Strong sales raise the profit that finance reports
A cheaper supplier lowers the cost of each product made
a.why: The campaign can only run with the money finance provides, so a smaller budget limits what marketing can do. The loan and profit options are tempting, but they show marketing affecting finance, which is the opposite direction.
a.clue: Ask which area acts first and which one has to respond.
